author: Mark Manson
description:
What most people call “disciplined” is usually just repetition that has stopped asking for permission. The brain doesn’t build habits through inspiration—it builds them through context and exposure until the behavior becomes automatic.


Watch the full episode to find out which one is keeping you stuck: https://open.spotify.com/episode/6vgdtETFrsxnazLmJaobAE?si=k3i3ll9JQlmxHnmbexBWlA

title: The Unsexy Truth About Discipline
